decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to utilize the Cascade mechanic to continuously cycle through your deck and control the board until you can cast Living End to bring all your creatures back from the graveyard and overwhelm your opponent. The deck focuses on cycling through cards quickly with Architects of Will, Street Wraith, and Curator of Mysteries, while using Force of Negation to protect your combo pieces. Utilizing Waker of Waves and Grief for disruption, this combo-heavy deck aims to win through a massive board presence and overwhelming your opponent.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive plays and disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Grief. It utilizes low-cost creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker as well as removal spells like Terminate to control the board. The deck also includes graveyard recursion with cards like Feign Death and Undying Malice to maintain pressure on the opponent. With a mix of disruptive elements, removal, and aggressive creatures, this deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent and secure a victory.

This deck focuses on using counterspells and removal to control the game, while utilizing powerful artifacts like Leyline Binding and The One Ring to gain advantage and assert dominance. Teferi, Time Raveler helps to control the tempo of the game, while cards like Subtlety and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse provide additional disruption. The deck is designed to slow down the opponent's strategy and eventually overwhelm them with a combination of powerful creatures and artifacts. The strategy revolves around keeping the opponent's threats in check while building up your own board presence.

The key concept of this deck is to utilize the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Urza's Tower, Urza's Power Plant) to generate large amounts of mana, allowing for the casting of powerful spells and threats. It focuses on control elements, including board wipes like Oblivion Stone and relic removal with Relic of Progenitus. The deck also includes powerful creatures like Wurmcoil Engine and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger as win conditions. It utilizes card selection and filtering with cards like Ancient Stirrings and Chromatic Sphere to ensure consistent plays. Karn, the Great Creator is used for additional control and artifact manipulation.

The main concept of this deck is to play aggressively using cheap spells and creatures to chip away at the opponent's life total quickly. The deck includes a mix of burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart, as well as efficient creatures like Sprite Dragon and Monastery Swiftspear. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional value and flexibility. The deck aims to maintain pressure on the opponent while protecting its own creatures with cards like Mutagenic Growth and Soul-Scar Mage.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and powerful spells. By utilizing cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while continuously applying pressure. The use of efficient removal spells like Terminate and Fatal Push helps to clear the way for your creatures to attack. Additionally, cards like Dauthi Voidwalker and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide additional disruption and value. This Rakdos Aggro deck is designed to be fast-paced and proactive, aiming to win the game before the opponent can stabilize.

This deck aims to control the game by using a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six. It also utilizes the landfall ability of cards like Omnath, Locus of Creation to generate value and overwhelm the opponent with threats. The inclusion of Leyline Binding and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines helps to further control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Overall, the deck is designed to outlast and outmaneuver the opponent through a combination of resource denial and card advantage.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures and disruptive spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck aims to consistently apply pressure with efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Terminate. By combining aggressive creatures with disruptive spells, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while pushing through damage quickly, ultimately leading to a swift victory in the fast-paced Modern format.

The main focus of this deck is to deal damage quickly and efficiently to your opponent, utilizing a mix of burn spells and aggressive creatures. With a combination of direct damage spells like Lightning Bolt, Lava Spike, and Boros Charm, along with efficient creatures like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear, this deck aims to quickly bring your opponent's life total down to zero. The inclusion of cards like Roiling Vortex and Searing Blaze help to maintain pressure on the opponent, while also providing some flexibility in dealing with opposing threats.

This deck focuses on using Death's Shadow as a powerful early threat, backed up by disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Counterspell to control the game. The deck also includes efficient removal in Fatal Push and Dismember to clear the way for Death's Shadow to attack. The deck can quickly reduce its own life total to grow Death's Shadow and take advantage of its low mana cost. Additionally, the deck includes cards that enable graveyard recursion and card advantage to maintain pressure on the opponent.

The primary focus of this deck is to aggressively disrupt the opponent's hand and board state while quickly deploying threats to pressure the opponent's life total. By utilizing efficient removal like Fatal Push and Terminate alongside disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Grief, the deck aims to keep the opponent on the back foot. The creatures in the deck, such as Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker, are used to quickly close out the game once the opponent's resources are depleted. Overall, the deck is designed to apply constant pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

This deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Territorial Kavu to quickly deal damage to the opponent. The deck also utilizes burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Tribal Flames to finish off the opponent. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion allows for additional mana acceleration and flexibility. The deck runs a mix of fetch lands and triomes to ensure consistent mana fixing. Overall, the key strategy of this deck is to apply early pressure and maintain board presence to overwhelm the opponent.

The deck also utilizes powerful artifacts like Karn, the Great Creator and Leyline Binding to disrupt the opponent's game plan. This deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a fast and aggressive tempo, utilizing efficient spells and creatures to maintain pressure on the opponent. By combining cheap threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler with disruptive spells like Counterspell and Spell Pierce, the deck aims to control the game while dealing consistent damage. Murktide Regent provides a powerful late-game threat, while cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration help with card selection and maintaining card advantage. The deck is designed to quickly close out games before the opponent can stabilize.
